thesis_summary.thesis: CleanSpark is a U.S.-listed bitcoin miner that owns power-backed data center sites, operates roughly **1,027 megawatts** of infrastructure, and runs **336,544** ASIC miners (**241,934** in service at September 30, 2025). **[Fact]** FY2025 digital currency mining revenue was **$766.3 million** (+102% versus **$379.0 million** in FY2024). **[Fact]** Average operational hash rate was **45.6 exahash per second** (**4.3%** of global network hash). **[Fact]** FY2025 operating cash flow was **$461.0 million** and capital spending on productive assets was **$144.7 million**. **[Fact]** The company sells the majority of mined bitcoin for working capital but began retaining treasury balances and running a Digital Asset Management (Spot+) covered-call program in April 2025. **[Fact]** In October 2025 management added an AI data center leader and signed a non-binding framework with Submer for modular AI cooling while acquiring **271 acres** in Texas with **285 megawatts** of contracted power for future high-performance computing.
thesis_summary.why_market_wrong: **Predictive attribute:** complexity discount (GAAP earnings dominated by bitcoin fair-value marks, convertibles, and an unproven AI hosting pivot).

key_assumptions.input: Starting free cash flow per share
key_assumptions.source: FY2025 operating cash flow $461.0M minus capital spending on productive assets $144.7M = $316.3M owner cash; divided by 317.8M FY2025 diluted shares (10-K FY2025 cash flow statement)
Flat-to-modest owner cash on 45+ EH/s fleet; treasury/DAM supplements ops; HPC option not in Lawrence FCF path

open_questions: Verify CEO transition/comp package (August 2025 severance **$20 million** stock comp in Adjusted EBITDA reconciliation) against governance quality.
Decide whether H1 FY2026 hashprice decline is cyclical or structural before upgrading stance.
AI hosting option remains **[Assumption]** until contracted revenue appears in filings.
